detail.title: 4 × 4 MP Multi-Sensor Panoramic Bullet Wizmind Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-PFW81642-A180 4 × 4 MP Multi-Sensor Panoramic Bullet Wizmind Network Camera Key Points • 16 MP Ultra-High-Definition Resolution, Outputs Max. 16MP (5520 × 2700) @30 fps • 180° Splicing Image. Field of View: H: 180°; V: 100° • 4 × 4MP, 1/1.8" CMOS Image Sensors • Built-in IR LED, the Max. Illumination Distance is 30 m • AI Functions: Crowd Map, Vehicle Density, Perimeter Protection, EPTZ • IP67 and IK10 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments • AR Panorama Technology, Various AR Tags Can be Overlaid Sales Enquiry Datasheet
